messages.content: Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?

function.name: science_history_get_invention
function.description: Retrieve the inventor and year of invention based on the invention's name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

want_year.description: Return the year of invention if set to true.

message.content:
**Albert Einstein** is credited with inventing the theory of relativity.

| Version | Year of publication |
|---------|---------------------|
| Special Theory of Relativity | **1905** (the “Annus Mirabilis” papers) |
| General Theory of Relativity | **1915** (published in *Annalen der Physik*) |

So, Einstein introduced the first part of the theory in 1905, and completed the full general theory a decade later in 1915.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?" They want the inventor and year. The theory of relativity is attributed to Albert Einstein. The year? The special theory of relativity was published in 1905. The general theory of relativity was published in 1915. The question might refer to the theory of relativity as a whole. Usually it's Einstein, 1905 (special) and 1915 (general). The user didn't specify special or general. We can answer: Albert Einstein, 1905 for special relativity, 1915 for general relativity. But maybe they want just one year. The question: "Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?" Could be interpreted as the theory of relativity as a whole. The earliest publication was 1905. So answer: Albert Einstein, 1905. But we can mention both. The user didn't ask for both. But we can provide both. The user might want the year of invention. The theory of relativity was developed by Einstein in 1905 (special) and 1915 (general). So answer accordingly. No function call needed.
